label: Bounded #320 follow-up to PR633 on a separate branch
summary:
Bounded #320 follow-up to PR633 on a separate branch. Found and proved that weak causal connectivity plus upstream confluence plus ONE source witness gives the existing RootedAtUniqueSource conclusion without WF. Mathlib equivalence_join and EqvGen.eqvGen_le join each node with the source, whose extension collapses by normality; head induction converts the other ReflTransGen path to the exact existing FiniteCausalPath. SourceForest.atMostOne_of_confluent supplies uniqueness. Thus WF was sufficient for obtaining a source from population, not required for paths after a source is supplied. No source premise is defended by this change. Reused unchanged GroundingAllowsRegress.link through the existing WorldSourceRegress.overlap actual graph; direct finite paths to none make it weakly connected and upstream-confluent. Imported overlapControl supplies source existence, acyclicity, the same actual some0 anchored infinite injective regress and non-Acc, giving notWF. The rooted finite paths coexist with that infinite branch; rejected identifying a finite path to a source with finite ancestry, termination of every branch, or no regress. No new model, source attribution or explanatory adequacy is asserted. Frozen follow-up Challenge SHA25677c9b67d562165a7ac86a838ff55b0311f13cbf46f1d13716bc4a792a538dbbc; all PR633 files and frozen Challenges unchanged. Shared-service full-content Scratch/issue320-witness/Proof.lean under /tmp/truth-core-lean.lock, causal-harvest at a13fc469, HTTP200, wait0, v2 no diagnostics; content SHA256d61812a49b61842e1b414911a65942239518b30f4e5b0fba323dde5efea4d88f. Interactive elaboration is not final Comparator/NanoDa certification. Intended and actual root-premise delta zero: none added/removed/discharged. All actual causal applicability remains open. PR633 is now merged; the own staged commit was cherry-picked onto fresh main5da45a32 for a separate direct-main follow-up, with no parent diff duplicated. Accepted proof inputs are unchanged and final canonical certification remains CI-owned.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). b06d45ee tests 25697a6f. Test the stronger well-foundedness requirement on the same actual graph. All Option Nat bearers are present at the sole world. The source none has a direct edge to every some n, but some 0 has the injective upstream branch some 1, some 2 and onward and is inaccessible. b06d45ee tests 688bfc49. Witness connectivity, confluence and a source together on the infinite populated actual graph at the sole world. Every some n has a direct upstream path to none, so distinct finite upstream endpoints can be extended to none. The relation also admits an infinite upstream branch. b06d45ee tests a86ff6ca. Witness the joint weak-connectivity and confluence premises on the infinite all-present graph. Every node has an upstream extension to none, which is itself a source. There are no incoming edges to none.

current_assessment.scope: When one source path suffices for termination, and when a secondary can give esse to the same recipient as a maximal giver under that condition.
current_assessment.assessment: Starting at an actual concrete bearer, one finite path to a source with no actual concrete supplier suffices for well-foundedness of its complete ancestry if every pair of distinct suppliers of every member has a common immediate supplier, with immediacy fixed by the selected edges. The checked cone with infinitely many suppliers has depth two. Finite access to one source from every member alone admits an endless secondary line. One Git merge passes the local test while unequal lengths to one initial commit exclude the condition across its ancestry. Under universal esse giving by a maximum and causal ascent at esse, strict joining on the actual esse relation is equivalent to all incoming gifts to this recipient coming from that maximum. A secondary giving esse here excludes that combination if both gifts use the same edges. A secondary may give another respect. If the primary only supplies through an intermediary, its universal giving on immediate edges requires a further premise.
current_assessment.next_test: Identify the dependent whose existence the rim and spokes each directly supply. Check whether the same bearer directly supplies the existence of both parts and whether the first giver also gives the dependent its esse in this very relation. One matched fork is local evidence. Two source-ending paths of unequal length at the dependent would exclude strict joining across its ancestry.
current_assessment.evidence: The selected-source result a18f7922 proves termination, equal lengths and the necessary-ancestor composition under their stated premises. Its controls include a genuine diamond, an infinite-width depth-two cone, a common-source regress and a three-bearer change of edge scope. The same-giver result 53348c1f includes a secondary esse giver in a model of the universal gift and ascent at esse. The earlier 74caa472 inference supplies this fixed-respect ascent from the broader d5a94eb1. The linked Git parent records provide a separate check on the local-to-global inference. Independent review at 9bd686ff accepted the finite-depth proof, infinite-width control and fixed-esse application, with actual grounding and causal mode open. Published in PR #2010.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. The #320 result on finite paths under upstream confluence and its regress control retain their original scope.
